explore:region.guide: Pick a flag. Let's explore together.
explore:region.guide__note: Atlas's short invitation above a region's country list. Invites the user to choose a country, not a flag quiz.
explore:search.clear__note: Button in empty country search results. Clears the search and restores the continent grid.
explore:title: Explore
explore:title__note: Screen title of the continents grid. Max 12 characters.
explore:subtitle: Seven continents. Start anywhere.
explore:region.facts__note: Label on the continent banner's progress bar. It counts FACTS, and it has to say so: the bar was labelled "Countries" while measuring facts, so the banner read "Countries 0 / 56" directly above "0 of 19 countries finished" — two different numbers for the same noun, six pixels apart. Max 28 characters.
explore:region.progress__note: Counts FACTS, not countries — 3 of 12 learned. Both are whole numbers.
explore:region.complete__note: Under the region progress bar. 'Finished' means every quizzable fact about that country is mastered — it is a statement of fact, not a nudge. Never phrased as how many are left.
explore:region.empty__note: Shown on a continent with no content in the shipped packs. Max 20 characters.
explore:region.due: {count, plural, =0 {Up to date} one {# review due} other {# reviews due}}
explore:region.due__note: How many facts in this continent are due for review. ICU plural. The =0 case means 'nothing is waiting for you', which is only true once something has been learned — a continent with nothing learned uses region.size instead.
explore:region.size: {count, plural, one {# country to meet} other {# countries to meet}}
explore:region.size__note: Shown on a continent the user has learned nothing in, where the reviews-due line has nothing to say. It replaced 'Not started yet', which was the third line in a row to mean 'zero' — under '0 of 56 learned' and an empty bar — so the tile spent its last line repeating itself. This one is the only number on the tile a user does not already have. Max 22 characters.
explore:region.label: {region}, {percent} complete
explore:region.label__note: Accessibility label grouping a continent card. {percent} already includes the % sign.
explore:world.label: Your world
explore:world.label__note: Heading above the overall progress bar. Max 16 characters.
explore:world.countries__note: Overall count on the world progress bar. Whole numbers.
explore:countries.title: Countries
explore:countries.title__note: Heading of the list inside a continent. Max 14 characters.
explore:countries.empty.title: No countries here yet
explore:countries.empty.body: More of the world arrives with every content update.
explore:mastery.unseen__note: A country the user has never been asked about. Max 14 characters.
explore:mastery.burnished__note: The level above mastered — kept fresh over months. Max 14 characters.
explore:search.label: Search countries or regions
explore:search.reset__note: Accessible label for the close icon inside country search. Clears only the query.
explore:search.more__note: Expands a search from six results to every matching country. {count} is the total result count.
explore:search.fewer__note: Collapses an expanded country search back to the first six matches.
explore:search.label__note: Country search over installed content. Keep concise; count is validated coverage, not worldwide total.
explore:search.count: {count, plural, one {# country in this course} other {# countries in this course}}
explore:search.count__note: Country search over installed content. Keep concise; count is validated coverage, not worldwide total.
explore:search.empty: No matching countries. Try another name or region.
explore:search.empty__note: Country search over installed content. Keep concise; count is validated coverage, not worldwide total.
